proposals.evidence: Full nikta gives its Middle Indo-Aryan replacement *nikka, Lahnda nikkā “small, young”, Khetrani nikṛā and Western Pahari nikṛo “small”. Both members of each selected Awankari slash response belong to this same nikkā/nikṛā family, so the complete response is covered; mixed nikkā plus choṭā/nanḍā responses remain excluded.
